```{r libraries, results='hide', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)
library(kableExtra)
library(mgcv)
library(gratia)

library(scoringutils)
library(hubUtils)
library(hubEnsembles)
library(hubData)
```

# Data
```{r}
standard_wis <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/standard-scoring/standard_wis.csv")
```

```{r}
state_locations <- c("colorado", "georgia", "indiana", "maine", "maryland", "massachusetts", 
                     "minnesota", "north-carolina", "oregon", "south-carolina", "texas", "utah", "virginia")

standard_wis <- standard_wis %>%
  mutate(
    wis = as.numeric(wis),
    horizon  = horizon - 1
  ) %>%
  filter(wis > 0, !is.infinite(log(wis)), !is.na(wis))

# standard_wis$model_id <- as.factor(standard_wis$model_id)
# standard_wis$horizon <- as.factor(standard_wis$horizon)

standard_wis$horizon = as.character(standard_wis$horizon)

standard_wis$model_id <- droplevels(as.factor(standard_wis$model_id))
standard_wis$location <- droplevels(as.factor(standard_wis$location))
standard_wis$horizon <- droplevels(as.factor(standard_wis$horizon))
```

# Model effects
```{r}
model <- gam(
  wis ~ s(model_id, bs = "re") +  
        s(location, bs = "re") +
        s(horizon, bs = "re"),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = standard_wis
)

summary(model)
```

```{r}
estimates <- smooth_estimates(model)

horizon_ci <- estimates |>
  filter(.smooth == "s(horizon)") |>
  select(.smooth, horizon, .estimate, .se) |>
  rename(est = .estimate, se = .se) |>
  mutate(
    ci_lower = est - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = est + 1.96 * se
  )

knitr::kable(horizon_ci |> arrange(est) |> select(-.smooth)) 

model_id_ci <- estimates |>
  filter(.smooth == "s(model_id)") |>
  select(.smooth, model_id, .estimate, .se) |>
  rename(est = .estimate, se = .se) |>
  mutate(
    ci_lower = est - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = est + 1.96 * se
  )

knitr::kable(model_id_ci |> arrange(est) |> select(-.smooth)) 

location_ci <- estimates |>
  filter(.smooth == "s(location)") |>
  select(.smooth, location, .estimate, .se) |>
  rename(est = .estimate, se = .se) |>
  mutate(
    ci_lower = est - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = est + 1.96 * se
  )
```

# Subfigures
```{r}
fig4a = ggplot(horizon_ci, aes(x = factor(horizon), y = est)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), width = 0.2) + 
  geom_point(size = 5, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(y = "Effect (WIS)", x = "Horizon") +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_flip() + 
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 17),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 17)  
  ) 
```

```{r}
fig4b = ggplot(location_ci, aes(x = reorder(location, est), y = est)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Location", y = "Effect on WIS")
```

```{r}
fig4c = ggplot(model_id_ci, aes(x = reorder(model_id, -est), y = est)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), width = 0.2) +
  geom_point(color = "seagreen", size = 5) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(y = "Effect (WIS)", x = "Model") +
  theme_bw() + 
  coord_flip() + 
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 17),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 17)  
  )
```
